name: memory_consolidate
description: Trigger a manual memory consolidation cycle. Consolidation lifts episodic traces into semantic or procedural tiers with lineage, compacts tombstoned records, and updates decay strengths. This is one of the four required MF-001 operations (remember, recall, consolidate, forget). Use this after a batch of ingestions or before a reflection cycle to ensure the memory store is optimized.

namespace.description: Target memory namespace (slug or ID). Omit to use connection or account default.
